newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amalgamated expands into Middle East.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amalgamated expands into Middle East.

text.p: Leisure and entertainment group Amalgamated Holdings Ltd said on Friday that its subsidiary Greter Union would expand into the Middle East with the construction of a multi-screen cinema complex in Dubai, scheduled to commence in late 1996.

Amalgamated said the 10 screen complex was a joint venture between Greter Union and Middle East business and trading group Majid Al Futtaim Investments Llc which was representing multinational company's from Japan, United States and Europe.
"The multiplex will be the first for the Gulf States and will be housed within Dubai's Deira City Complex Centre, stage one of which opened in December 1995," the company said.
The company said the complex was scheduled to open for trading in late 1997.
